flags: All three current moments retained, reversed into southbound order to match supplied strip miles from Plymouth Meeting toward Eddystone. No coordinates were present in those moments. Roadside means a feature passed on the drive, not a stopping place.

Current factual claims have cache support. Removed the Inquirer superlative because only Wikipedia’s reproduction is cached, and replaced “twenty miles through Delaware County” with the two-county scope confirmed by Visit Pennsylvania.

Wikipedia gives both December 1991 and December 1992 for final opening, with the latter tied to turnpike connections. Omitted a single completion date. The 1985 design agreement and 1993 legislative designation remain distinct.

Wikipedia mentions shoulder-lane work expected in 2026. No current PennDOT project page is cached; lane-design history is described as history, not a guarantee of present configuration. No driving time is supported.
Radnor moment is deliberately short: the cache supports its material, location, artist and commemorative purpose, but little further site history.
